examples.fr: Il ressentit une douleur vive à la poitrine après sa longue course sous la pluie.
examples.en: He felt a sharp pain in his chest after his long run in the rain.

examples.fr: Elle posa la main sur sa poitrine pour calmer les battements de son cœur.
examples.en: She put her hand on her chest to calm the beating of her heart.

reasons: zh added a meat sense (胸肉) not present in the en gloss (chest, breast, breasts, bosom)
second example used the culinary 'pork belly' sense not in en and rendered it as unnatural 'pork breast'; replaced with example matching the listed senses
